question: If p – (1)/(p) = 6, then what is the value of p⁴ + (1)/({{p⁴)}}?
solution:
**Given:**

The expression p-(1)/(p)=6

**Formula Used:**

a² + b² = (a - b)²+ 2ab

**Calculation:**

p⁴ + (1)/(p⁴)

⇒ (p²+(1)/(p²))² - 2 × p² × (1)/(p²)

⇒ {(p-(1)/(p))²+ (2 × p × (1)/(p))}² - 2

⇒ {(6)² + 2}² - 2

⇒ (36 + 2)² - 2

⇒ (38)² - 2

⇒ 1444 - 2

⇒ 1442

**Hence the value of the expression p4 +(1)/(p⁴) is 1442.**
